title: This Repo Makes Your AI Write Less Code (ponytail)
description:
A GitHub repo just passed 74,000 stars for making your AI write less code, not more.

It's called ponytail. It forces your AI to ask if the code even needs to exist, then take the shortest path. Instead of installing a whole library for a date picker, you get one line of HTML. The controversial part: you might not even need it. Just telling your AI to write the least code and use built-in tools first gets you most of the way there.

Grab the repo here 👇🏻
https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail

Prefer a DM? Follow me on Instagram and comment "LAZY" and I'll send it over.
